visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black long-sleeved sweater and light-colored beige trousers sits in front of a white curtain. He looks directly at the lens with a friendly expression, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (2) The camera pans to the right to reveal an indoor living room setup. A large television screen displays a video of several colorful bottle caps floating down a rocky stream in nature. A man in a black shirt sits on the right side of the frame, holding food and eating it while watching the screen. (3) The shot widens to show two more men sitting in chairs against a white wall. They are both dressed in black outfits, laughing heartily and reacting with excitement while watching the TV screen. The room features a wooden ceiling and modern furniture, with some posters or notices on the wall. (4) A closer shot of the television highlights the bottle cap race in the stream. The men's laughter continues off-camera. On the TV, blue, yellow, green, and red bottle caps navigate around small rocks in the water. The overall environment is warm and domestic.
